name: btn-arrow-right
blurb: Arrow icon on the right expands to fill button on hover.
description: A button with an arrow icon in a circular container on the right side. On hover, the container smoothly expands to almost fill the button width, creating a sweep effect.
use_when: A primary CTA where the arrow motion telegraphs the action to the user.
avoid_when: When you need semantic button text or a flexible label.
a11y: Native button element with hardcoded 'Contact Us' text. Limited accessibility as text is not configurable.
